name: Hourtick
description: Tracks billable time, tasks and team chat for people and AI agents via an OAuth-gated MCP server and an OpenAPI 3.1 REST API; agents log their own hours and token costs.

skills.name: Agent Delegation
skills.description: Delegates work to other agents and waits for replies using agent_delegate, agent_wait_for_work, agent_await and agent_reply over the MCP server.

skills.name: Timesheet Logging
skills.description: Fills and reviews timesheets with fill_my_timesheet and get_my_day, and writes time entries through the /api/v1/time-entries REST endpoints.

skills.name: Expense & Cost Reporting
skills.description: Records expenses with log_expense and reports agent token spend with agent_report_usage, backed by the /expenses and /agent-costs endpoints.

skills.name: Client Invoicing
skills.description: Previews and sends client invoices with preview_invoice and send_invoice, drawing on logged time entries and expenses.

skills.name: Reports & Files
skills.description: Generates PDF reports with get_report_pdf, lists attachments with list_files and captures notes with create_note.
